𝗠𝘆𝘁𝗵 𝘃𝘀 𝗙𝗮𝗰𝘁: 𝘀𝘂𝗯𝘀𝗰𝗿𝗶𝗯𝗲𝗿 𝗸𝗮𝗺 𝘁𝗼 𝘃𝗶𝗱𝗲𝗼 𝗻𝗮𝗵𝗶𝗻 𝗰𝗵𝗮𝗹𝗲𝗴𝗮? ❌
Myth: Subscribers kam hain to koi video nahi dekhega.
Fact: YouTube mainly dekhta hai ki viewers ko video pasand aaya ya nahi.
👉 Viewer ko kaam ka content do
👉 Ek topic par tikke raho
👉 Pehle seconds mein hook rakho
Subscribers ginti nahi, viewers ka experience matter karta hai.
Aapko ye myth kisne bataya tha? Comment mein batao 👇
